name: boost-saspoint5

runtime.scope: Full Boost Saspoint5 PDF FP64; three synthetic 65539-element inputs; sm70; block256; long-double CPU oracle

provenance.inputs: new deterministic synthetic fixtures, not historical CUDA inputs or official Boost.Random sequence

validation.checks: CPU long-double tolerance, guards, exact baseline output bytes

benchmark.limitation: resident external CUDA process; no exclusive confirmation; short timing quantization

limitations: New synthetic inputs; not a replication of the missing historical CUDA experiment.
Explicit Boost GPU annotations and Clang allow-variadic-functions compatibility flag; shared pinned headers unmodified.
All variants start from same aggressively inlined LLVM12 O3 baseline; NVCC is not the baseline compiler.
Only new synthetic finite fixtures tested; no proof of historical CUDA result replication or exclusive timing.
